scope: Read-only reference study: five AXAI maps plus two NKL and two SMAI maps; source identity, local native profiles and existing render observations. No playable-map edits or unit movement tests.

coordinate_system.sample_spacing: one native terrain sample; no inference from PNG pixels
coordinate_system.profile_axis: axis_grid is displacement direction for signed distance_cells; inspect actual coordinates and z, not all profiles run low to high or offshore to inland

measurement_limits: Impassability is one native bitmap only; impassability=false is not proof of unit passability, water occupancy, buildability or bidirectional navigation.
Existing ramp-candidate width is connected gradient-region extent, not guaranteed full effective movement width.
Profiles are local examples, not whole-map or full-shoreline coverage.
Actual StandingWaterAreas are read; still photographs do not validate movement.
Previously exported WorldBuilder overviews were not re-exported for this study and have no proven same-version binding to the native maps. Their crops support visual observations only.

figures.method: crop original existing WB overview, composite alpha over RGB(20,26,34), bilinear display resize, add labels; no generated terrain content

verification.scope: reference study only; no current playable-map acceptance

extraction_method.coordinate_mapping: north-up sample (x,y) maps to native linear index (H-1-y)*W+x; all exported height/tiles/imp arrays already north-up

blend_tile_v27.impassability: bitfield starts 4+8*N; row stride ceil(W/8), x low bit first

extraction_method.source_policy: external originals remain local; SHA256 and sampled facts archived; cached work paths are provenance labels, not production dependencies

NKL: One native impassability bit is not proof of unit movement, water occupancy, buildability or bidirectional navigation.
Existing ramp-candidate width is a gradient-region extent, not effective movement width.
Local profiles do not cover all map boundaries.
Existing WB exports are not proven to bind to current originals. Twisted Megma export has conspicuous rendering defects in middle/right/lower areas; do not read those artifacts as native geometry.
SMAI: Impassability is one native bitmap only; false does not establish unit passage, buildability, water occupancy or bidirectional navigation.
Existing ramp-candidate width is connected gradient-region extent and is not full effective movement width.
Profiles are local examples and do not cover full ramps, all layer boundaries or whole shorelines.
Previously exported WorldBuilder overviews were inspected as visual references only; they were not regenerated and lack independently established same-version source binding.
SMAI slope/side-edge observations complement AXAI/NKL examples. No claim is made that original SMAI shorelines satisfy current project shoreline rules.

NKL.observation: Existing overview shows irregular raised plateaus; pale dirt paths run continuously through broad natural openings, with rocky cliff outlines interrupted at those openings; surrounding plateau dirt remains the background on both sides.
NKL.limit: Appearance only, not same-version or movement proof.

NKL.observation: Undamaged upper portion of the earlier overview shows light beaches tapering toward dark rocky headlands; dirt roads continue in the grassland interior instead of forming an isolated ramp rectangle.
NKL.limit: Do not infer underwater geometry or movement from colors; original native shore sample contains impassable bits.
